app.hintShort: Pick a unit: tap one of your men, a vehicle or a tile in the unit list. (Tap here for help.)
app.hintShortMouse: Pick a unit: click one of your men, a vehicle or a tile in the unit list. (Click here for help; keys: ?)
app.hint: Pick a unit: tap one of your men or vehicles, or its tile in the unit list. Drag from the unit to where it should go and let go: it moves. Drag its marker to change the move, onto the unit to halt it; drag the round handle to turn it. For a route, tap the map for each point, then Go. Fire: tap the target, or hold to see the sight lines (broken: blocked) and let go. The small arrows beside Move and Fire open the other orders (assault, withdraw, occupy, clear a house, posture; anti-tank, grenades, mortar, smoke, cease fire). Double-tap an order to keep it on. The unit card sets the pace and when the men fire; Men lists each soldier, tap one for his details. Drag the bar's grip to dock it. Pause any time: orders still work. Tap a tile to centre on the unit, hold it to follow. Keys and gestures: the ? button.

cmp.home.title: Battalion campaign

cmp.home.modeInfo: Operations: 3 to 5 linked battles on connected maps, the result picks the next battle; replacements and supplies arrive between operations. Endless: battles keep coming, with a replenishment every few battles.

menu.sub: Real-time tactical combat, platoon to company, present day. Choose how to play.
